post.caption: A piano hid 913 gold coins. A tuner was repairing a Broadwood piano at a Shropshire school. Under the keyboard, he found eight parcels. Inside were 913 gold sovereigns and half sovereigns. The coins were dated from 1847 to 1915. Together they weighed more than 6 kilograms. Cardboard from a Shredded Wheat advertisement dated the hiding to after 1926. A coroner declared it treasure, as no one knows who hid it. About 50 people came forward to claim it, and none had evidence. In all, 633 sovereigns and 280 half sovereigns.
